title: The Pup and the Nut
lines: A bug is on the nut!

questions.ask: What does Gus dig up in the mud?
questions.listenFor: A nut. It is stated in the story, so if they guess, send them back to find the line instead of telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Gus run to his hut?
questions.listenFor: The bug ran at him. You are listening for cause and effect - if they just say "the bug," ask "and what did the bug do?"

questions.ask: Do you think Gus was brave? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. What you want is a reason tied to the story - "no, he ran" or "yes, he dug up ten more."
